Canary + fallback plan (high level):

- Fallback chain: primary model=rfv-1.2-quant8 (low-latency variant) -> fallback model=rfv-1.2-quant4 (higher quality, slower) -> fallback hosted light model (hosted_api read-only) for catastrophic failure.

- Region failover: prefer local region (user->closest) with automated failover to alternate region if 95th p99 latency breach or instance OOM; automated routing will shift by policy and tag calls for replay.
- Rollback procedure: immediate traffic cut to 0% for affected pool, route to hosted_api stable variant, open incident (INF-xxxx), ship model rollback patch if regression tied to variant.
POC acceptance criteria (agreed):
- Error rate < 1% (5xx + model-serve errors) under steady state
- 95th percentile latency <= 300ms for chat paths (target 120ms for median),
- Embedding throughput >= 400 reqs/min at p50 latency < 400ms,
- No data residency violations for EU test accounts; logs anonymized during POC.
